name: Capital Gains Tax
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sanctity of inheritance and rightful possession, highlighting that inheritances should remain within families to preserve God's order and blessing, as seen in Numbers 36:8 and Ezekiel 46:18. Proverbs warns that hastily gained wealth or inheritance will not be blessed, underscoring the importance of godly stewardship (Proverbs 20:21, 13:22). Jeremiah 32:44 records the lawful buying and selling of land with proper witnesses, reflecting God's provision for orderly property transactions. Additionally, Matthew 22:17 acknowledges the legitimacy of paying tribute to governing authorities, which can be applied to understanding the biblical perspective on taxes related to property and gains.
